### Geographic Reach {#geo-rep}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "setup.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "load-data.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "map.R"), echo = FALSE)

institution_count <- institution_summary(data1)$unique_domains

```

Members are connecting from **`r geo$n_countries` countries**, based on IP address data. This provides a practical proxy for member distribution, though it may differ from self-reported country of residence. Data may reflect variance in locations due to travel or VPN use.

```{r}
#| label: geo-map

user_points <- geo_map$points

# Categorize user counts into custom bins
user_points$category <- cut(
  user_points$user_count,
  breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 50, Inf),
  labels = c("1–10", "11–20", "21–50", "51+"),
  right = TRUE,
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

# Sequential brand scale: more members, darker
custom_colors <- c(
  "1–10"  = collab$seq1,
  "11–20" = collab$seq2,
  "21–50" = collab$seq3,
  "51+"   = collab$seq4
)

# Hover text
user_points$hover_label <- paste0(
  "<b>", user_points$COUNTRY, "</b><br>",
  "Users: ", user_points$user_count
)

# Base ggplot
map_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = geo_map$base, fill = collab$bg_weaker, color = collab$fg_weakest, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(
    data = user_points,
    aes(size = user_count, fill = category, text = hover_label),
    shape = 21, color = collab$fg_weaker, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 15), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, name = "User Volume", drop = FALSE) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 6),
    title.position = "top",
    title.hjust = 0.5
  )) +
  theme_collab_map()

# Title and subtitle
map_plot +
  labs(
    title = "Member Access by Country",
    subtitle = glue("As of {fmt_date(snapshot_date)}")
  )
```

### Regional Reach

All WHO regions are represented among Collaboratory members. The charts show the percentage of members in each region, as well as the distribution of represented countries across regions.

```{r}
#| label: region-member-share
#| fig-height: 2



region_summary_filtered <- region_summary %>%
  mutate(
    prop_members = n_members / sum(n_members) * 100,
    who_region = fct_reorder(who_region, prop_members, .desc = TRUE)
  )

# Fixed WHO region colors
region_fills <- region_fill_values(levels(region_summary_filtered$who_region))

ggplot(region_summary_filtered, aes(x = 1, y = prop_members, fill = who_region)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.3, color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop_members, 1), "%"), group = who_region,
                color = label_color(region_fills[as.character(who_region)])),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = collab_size$label) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_fills) +
  labs(
    title = "Member Distribution by Region",
    subtitle = glue("As of {fmt_date(snapshot_date)}"),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = ""
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))+
  theme_collab_bar()


```

```{r}
#| label: region-country-share
#| fig-height: 2

region_summary_filtered_countries <- region_summary %>%
  mutate(
    prop_countries = n_countries / sum(n_countries) * 100,
    # Same factor order as the first plot, so colors and stacking match
    who_region = factor(who_region, levels = levels(region_summary_filtered$who_region))
  ) 

ggplot(region_summary_filtered_countries, aes(x = 1, y = prop_countries, fill = who_region)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.3, color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop_countries, 1), "%"), group = who_region,
                color = label_color(region_fills[as.character(who_region)])),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = collab_size$label) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_fills) +
  labs(
    title = "Country Distribution by Region",
    subtitle = glue("As of {fmt_date(snapshot_date)}"),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = ""
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_collab_bar()

```

### Institutions {#int-rep}

Collaboratory members come from **`r format_institutions(institution_count)` institutions worldwide**, based on email domain data. The chart shows the proportion of members with WHO-affiliated addresses (@who.int) compared with other institutions. While WHO staff make up a significant share, the platform also includes a broader network of global health professionals and organizations.

```{r}
#| label: who-affiliated-share
#| fig-height: 2

# Count WHO vs Non-WHO members (members with a known e-mail domain)
email_counts <- data1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(email_domain)) %>%
  mutate(domain = ifelse(is_who, "WHO Members", "Non-WHO Members")) %>%
  count(domain) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
    domain = factor(domain, levels = c("WHO Members", "Non-WHO Members"))
  )

ggplot(email_counts, aes(x = 1, y = prop_percent, fill = domain)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.3, color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop_percent, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = collab_size$label, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "WHO Members" = collab$brand,
      "Non-WHO Members" = collab$brand_stronger
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of WHO-affiliated Members",
    subtitle = glue("As of {fmt_date(snapshot_date)}"),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = ""
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_collab_bar()
```

### Disciplines {#dis-rep}

Member disciplinary information is **currently unreported**. Collecting data on members’ professional roles and expertise is planned to provide insights into the range of disciplines represented across the Collaboratory community.

### Gender Distribution {#gen-ratio}

Gender information for members is **currently unreported**. Collecting these data will help monitor diversity and inclusivity across the Collaboratory community.
